BindLeaderInstance.description_en: Binds a follower instance to a leader instance

ChangeResourceGroup.description_en: Updates the resource group of a Hologres instance

CreateInstance.description_en: Creates a Hologres instance in the specified region

CreateManualBackup.description_en: Creates a manual backup for an instance

CreateModelService.description_en: Creates a model service that allows AI functions to invoke models. You can create a service for two types of models: a model from Alibaba Cloud Model Studio or a model on a Hologres AI node. If you use a Hologres AI node, you must purchase the AI node resources separately
CreateModelService.description_zh: 创建模型服务，支持AI function调用模型。支持创建两类模型：1）阿里云百炼模型；2）Hologres AI节点。如果是Hologres AI，需要另外购买AI节点资源

CreateUser.description_en: Adds a RAM user or an STS account to a Hologres instance. Once added, the account can be used to log on to the instance
CreateUser.description_zh: 将Ram子账号/STS账号添加到Hologres实例，作为实例账号使用，添加后，即可以Ram/STS身份登陆实例

DeleteModelResource.description_en: Deletes a model resource. This action permanently deletes all models deployed on the node
DeleteModelResource.description_zh: 删除节点资源，节点部署的所有模型将被删除，不可恢复

DisableExecuteStatement.description_en: Shuts down the ExecuteStatement API access permissions for a specified Hologres instance
DisableExecuteStatement.description_zh: 关闭指定Hologres实例的ExecuteStatement API访问权限

DisableHiveAccess.description_zh: 该接口用于关闭数据湖加速

DisableSSL.description_en: Disables SSL encryption for a Hologres instance

DisableWarehouseAutoScale.description_en: Disables autoscale for a specified compute group

DiscardUpgrade.description_en: Cancels an upgrade. You can call this operation only if the upgrade task has not started or is in the `pre_check` state. You cannot cancel the upgrade after the task enters the `backup` state or any subsequent state
DiscardUpgrade.description_zh: 取消升级.请求条件：只在还未开始或者处于pre_check状态的任务按钮不置灰，显示为取消升级。一旦进入backup状态或者之后的状态，就不允许取消了

DropUser.description_en: Deletes a RAM user or an STS account from a Hologres instance. Once deleted, the user can no longer log in to the instance. To restore access, call the CreateUser operation to add the user
DropUser.description_zh: 将Ram子账号/STS账号从Hologres帐户体系删除，删除后，Ram/STS不能再登陆实例。如需登陆实例，请用CreateUser重新添加

EnableExecuteStatement.description_en: Enables SQL execution via OpenAPI for a specified Hologres instance
EnableExecuteStatement.description_zh: 为指定Hologres实例启用通过OpenAPI执行SQL的功能

EnableHiveAccess.description_en: Enables data lake acceleration for a Hologres instance
EnableHiveAccess.description_zh: 该接口用于开启数据湖加速

EnableSSL.description_en: Enables SSL encryption for a Hologres instance

EnableWarehouseAutoScale.description_en: Enables auto scaling for a warehouse

ExecuteStatement.description_en: Executes an SQL statement synchronously on a specified database via OpenAPI and returns the result
ExecuteStatement.description_zh: 通过OpenAPI在指定数据库上同步执行SQL语句并返回结果

GetCertificateAttribute.description_en: Retrieves the SSL certificate attributes of a Hologres instance, including SSL status and certificate expiration time

GetExecuteStatementEnabled.description_en: Checks whether a specified Hologres instance allows SQL execution through OpenAPI
GetExecuteStatementEnabled.description_zh: 检查指定Hologres实例是否已开启通过OpenAPI执行SQL的功能

GetHoloWebLoginSetting.description_en: Gets the external account login setting for HoloWeb

GetInstance.description_en: Retrieves the details of an instance
GetInstance.description_zh: 该接口用于获取实例详情

GetInstanceModel.description_en: Queries the list of large model services bound to a Hologres instance
GetInstanceModel.description_zh: Holo实例已经绑定的大模型服务列表

GetRootCertificate.description_en: Retrieves the root SSL certificate of a Hologres instance for client-side SSL connections

GetUpgradeStatus.description_en: Queries the upgrade status of an instance

GetUpgradeable.description_en: Queries whether an instance can be upgraded

GetWarehouseDetail.description_en: Retrieves the details of a virtual warehouse

GrantDatabasePermission.description_en: Grants permissions on a database to a specified user within a Hologres instance

GrantSchemaPermission.description_en: Grants permissions on a schema to a specified user within a Hologres instance

GrantTablePermission.description_en: Grants permissions on a table to a specified user

ListBackupData.description_en: Retrieves a list of snapshots. Each snapshot represents a point-in-time backup that can be used to restore a new instance with its full data
ListBackupData.description_zh: 该接口用于查询备份数据列表。一份备份是对实例截止快照时间的全量数据快照，可以通过新购实例完全恢复原来的数据

ListDatabases.description_en: Queries the databases in a Hologres instance

ListLeaderInstances.description_en: Retrieves a list of potential leader instances
ListLeaderInstances.description_zh: 获取可能的主实例Id列表

ListMigrationZones.description_en: Lists the availability zones to which an instance can be migrated. This operation applies to instances that are deployed across three availability zones
ListMigrationZones.description_zh: 查询可以迁移可用区。3AZ实例，可以在可用区之间自助迁移

ListOperationEvents.description_en: Retrieves action events that match specified criteria, supporting pagination and sorting
ListOperationEvents.description_zh: 获取指定条件下的操作事件列表，支持分页和排序

ListRegions.description_en: Queries the list of all regions supported by Hologres

ListUpgradeReleaseVersions.description_en: Retrieves the list of versions available for upgrade

ListWarehouseScheduleEvent.description_en: Retrieves the elastic scheduling events for a specified instance and time range
ListWarehouseScheduleEvent.description_zh: 查询指定实例在给定时间范围内的弹性调度事件

ListWarehouseScheduleTask.description_en: Lists all warehouse schedule tasks for a specified instance
ListWarehouseScheduleTask.description_zh: 获取指定实例下的所有计算组分时弹性计划任务列表

ListWarehouses.description_en: Retrieves a list of virtual warehouses

MigrateInstanceZone.description_en: Migrates an instance to a target availability zone. This operation only supports instances deployed across three availability zones. The instance is launched in the target availability zone without migrating its storage. The process takes approximately 5 minutes
MigrateInstanceZone.description_zh: 迁移实例到目标可用区。仅3AZ实例支持，无需迁移存储，直接在目标可用区启动实例，大约5分钟

PrepareUpgrade.description_en: Prepares an instance for an upgrade by running a pre-upgrade assessment. You can upgrade the instance only if the assessment passes. If it fails, contact technical support for a manual upgrade
PrepareUpgrade.description_zh: 启动升级前的准备。升级前需要做一轮评估，评估通过，则可以升级，否则需要联系人工升级

RebalanceHoloWarehouse.description_en: Rebalances shards in a virtual warehouse

RenewInstance.description_en: Renews a subscription Hologres instance. You can also enable monthly auto-renewal
RenewInstance.description_zh: 该接口用于为实例手动续费。可以在续费的同时开启按月自动续费

RenewSSLCertificate.description_en: Renews the SSL certificate of a Hologres instance

ResumeHoloWarehouse.description_en: Resumes a virtual warehouse from Stopped to Running
ResumeHoloWarehouse.description_zh: 从停机状态恢复到正常状态

RevokeDatabasePermission.description_en: Revokes permissions on a database from a specified user within a Hologres instance

RevokeSchemaPermission.description_en: Revokes permissions on a schema from a specified user within a Hologres instance

RevokeTablePermission.description_en: Revokes permissions on a table from a specified user

ScaleInstance.description_en: Changes the specifications and storage space of a Hologres instance
ScaleInstance.description_zh: 该接口用于变更实例的规格和存储空间

TagResources.description_en: Adds tags to one or more resources

UnBindLeaderInstance.description_en: Detaches a read-only instance from its primary instance

UntagResources.description_en: Removes tags from one or more instances

UpdateAutoUpgrade.description_en: Enables automatic minor version upgrades for an instance. The upgrade occurs automatically during the maintenance window
UpdateAutoUpgrade.description_zh: 开启小版本自动升级。开启后，将在运维时间窗口自动升级实例

UpdateBackupDataDesc.description_en: Updates the description of a backup

UpdateHoloWebLoginSetting.description_en: Modifies the login settings for holoweb

UpdateInstanceName.description_en: Changes the name of an instance
UpdateInstanceName.description_zh: 该接口用于修改实例名称

UpdateInstanceNetworkType.description_en: Modifies the network type of an instance
UpdateInstanceNetworkType.description_zh: 该接口用于修改实例网络类型

UpdateInstancePort.description_en: Updates the port of an instance

UpdateMaintenanceWindow.description_en: Updates the maintenance window of a specified instance
UpdateMaintenanceWindow.description_zh: 用于设定实例的可维护时间段，以便进行系统维护

UpdateModelService.description_en: Updates a model service. This operation applies only to Hologres AI
UpdateModelService.description_zh: 创建模型服务，只适用于Hologres AI

UpdateOperationEventScheduleTime.description_en: Updates the scheduled execution time for an operation event
UpdateOperationEventScheduleTime.description_zh: 修改运维事件执行时间

UpdateScheduledBackupConfig.description_en: This operation configures a backup policy for an instance. You can set a weekly schedule to back up an instance on specific days, such as every Monday, Wednesday, and Friday at 20:00:00. You can also specify the number of completed backups to retain. The system automatically deletes expired backups
UpdateScheduledBackupConfig.description_zh: 配置备份策略。以周为周期，可以指定一周内的数个固定日期启动实例备份，比如周一、周三、周五的20:00:00。已完成的备份，可以配置保留个数，过期的备份会被自动清理

UpdateWarehouseScheduleTask.description_en: Updates an elastic schedule for a warehouse
UpdateWarehouseScheduleTask.description_zh: 更新计算组分时弹性计划

UpgradeInstance.description_en: Upgrades an instance. If the preparation is successful, the instance can start the upgrade directly
UpgradeInstance.description_zh: 升级实例。如果Prepare成功，则实例可以直接开始升级
